raw_segments.text: Rubbing smartly in turn, each welt against her stockined calf.
Morning after the bizarre dance when May's band played Panchielli's Dance of the Hours.
Explain that, morning hours noon then evening coming on,
then night hours, washing her teeth.
That was the first night, her head dancing, her fan sticks clicking.
Why, I noticed he had a good rich smell off his breath dancing.
No use humming then, allude to it.
Strange kind of music that last night.
She rubbed her hands less briskly on her woolen vest against her full wagging
bub, peering into it, lines in her eyes.
